name: contract-duplicate-matrix-rows
goal: Reject duplicate state and input matrix rows without blocking distinct boundaries or viewports

evidence: An API can add two identical cases under one newly declared state; both registry admission and case comparison currently accept them.
The existing compare case rejects an extra old-state row but never supplies duplicate new-state rows; the validator case likewise checks duplicate IDs but not duplicate behavior coordinates.
The existing validate and compare cases both accept the same new API matrix row twice and fail their strengthened assertions.
Validate distinct state, input, fixture and viewport coordinates, and reject duplicate new cases during comparison.
The same validate and compare cases pass at f43d0d427e, including distinct boundaries, viewport overlap and admitted cyclic input graphs.
